terms.definition: A J-shaped muscular bag that churns food and starts breaking it down.
terms.function: Mixes food with acid and enzymes.
terms.whyItMatters: It is where digestion really begins.

terms.definition: The acid and enzymes produced by the stomach lining.
terms.function: Breaks down food and kills germs.
terms.whyItMatters: It starts protein digestion and protects the body.

terms.definition: The soupy mixture of partly digested food.
terms.function: Moves from the stomach to the small intestine.
terms.whereItIs: In the stomach, then the small intestine.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the form food takes as digestion proceeds.

terms.definition: The protective coating on the stomach wall.
terms.function: Protects the stomach from its own acid.
terms.whyItMatters: Without it the stomach would digest itself.
